source.presence_only: Arrow is_valid bitmap; no conversion of numerical OI values, numeric comparisons, ranking, statistics or persistence

selection: all exact SECIDs with at least one non-NULL openposition across the sealed source, regardless of value or outcome; acquisition selection only, never historical inference eligibility
limitations: is_valid means non-NULL, not necessarily positive, finite or economically usable OI. No values are inspected at this stage.
Union over source dates selects what to archive, not what was known at an earlier decision; missing OI rows stay in all coverage denominators.
Static contract strikes, sizes, types and expiry dates are not traded market prices. No market prices,returns,labels,targets,fit orPnL are read or computed.
Every selected SECID gets its own exact description or explicit gap. Do not infer dates/underlyings from neighbouring strikes or eight examples.
Current descriptions may reflect later changes. Source completion is not original-PIT proof or admission of the later pinning hypothesis.
Existing V39,V68,V88 canonical artifacts remain unchanged. Calendar sample does not prove active-list coverage or numericOPTION_SERIES_ID mapping.
One immutable census, then one description acquisition with explicit census SHA beforeHTTP. No automatic restart, no canonical rerun, no new trading engine.
